# Security policy

Canonical policy (French + English pointers): see repository root [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).

- Private reports: [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/arkalia-luna-system/bbia-sim/security/advisories/new)
- Email: `arkalia.luna.system@gmail.com` with subject `[SECURITY] bbia-sim …`
- Robot physical safety (BBIA guards): [`docs/hardware/SECURITE_ROBOT.md`](../docs/hardware/SECURITE_ROBOT.md)

BBIA is **sim-first**. Physical robot access requires explicit `BBIA_ALLOW_HARDWARE=1`. Firmware issues belong to [Pollen reachy_mini](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/reachy_mini), not BBIA.
